strings.name: Wang Chuanfu
strings.role: BYD founder · Batteries and electric vehicles
strings.summary: Wang Chuanfu moved from metallurgical chemistry into battery entrepreneurship, founding BYD before entering car manufacturing. He connected batteries, electric motors and vehicle production, expanding beyond consumer electronics into electric mobility and energy storage. His influence lies in industrial engineering and manufacturing at scale; technologies such as the Blade Battery are the work of company teams, not his sole inventions.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through 13 November 2026; selected events reach 28 October 2026. Birth month follows BYD's official biography. Product milestones illustrate his career without implying sole inventorship or endorsing performance claims.

strings.highlights.highlight-01.title: From batteries to cars
strings.highlights.highlight-01.text: Founded BYD and entered car manufacturing in 2003, connecting battery research with the vehicle supply chain.
strings.highlights.highlight-02.title: Industrial electrification
strings.highlights.highlight-02.text: Led BYD's battery and vehicle expansion; in 2022 it ended combustion-only car production while retaining plug-in hybrids and battery-electric models.
strings.timeline.event-01.title: Receives the Rao Bin Award
strings.timeline.event-01.text: Honored at the Chinese automotive engineering congress in Suzhou for contributions to the automotive industry.
strings.timeline.event-02.title: Second-generation Blade Battery
strings.timeline.event-02.text: BYD introduced its second-generation Blade Battery and FLASH Charging, emphasizing charging speed and cold-weather performance.
strings.timeline.event-03.title: Ends combustion-only car production
strings.timeline.event-03.text: BYD shifted vehicle production toward battery-electric and plug-in hybrid models.
strings.timeline.event-04.title: Introduces the Blade Battery
strings.timeline.event-04.text: BYD launched the Blade Battery and used it in the Han EV, expanding lithium iron phosphate applications.
strings.timeline.event-05.title: Enters car manufacturing
strings.timeline.event-05.text: The acquisition of Qinchuan Auto marked expansion from battery supplier to vehicle manufacturer.
strings.timeline.event-06.title: Founds BYD
strings.timeline.event-06.text: Established BYD in Shenzhen, initially manufacturing rechargeable batteries.
strings.timeline.event-07.title: Completes a master's degree
strings.timeline.event-07.text: Completed postgraduate study at the Beijing Nonferrous Metals Research Institute before engineering and research work.
strings.timeline.event-08.title: Completes undergraduate studies
strings.timeline.event-08.text: Graduated from Central South University of Technology in metallurgical physical chemistry.
strings.timeline.event-09.title: Born in Wuwei, Anhui
